history.summary: Introduced an explicit trusted-proxy configuration and a reusable middleware/clientip resolver implementing the binding right-to-left X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP trust algorithm using only net/netip. Removed gorilla/handlers.ProxyHeaders from both the admin and phishing handler chains (it rewrote r.RemoteAddr unconditionally from client-controlled headers with no trust check) and replaced it in the same chain slot with the new resolver's safe middleware. Wired middleware/ratelimit.PostLimiter to the new resolver via a WithClientIP option instead of raw r.RemoteAddr, fixed the pollCleanup double-multiplication ticker bug (cleanupInterval was being multiplied by time.Second again, inflating 1 minute to ~147.7 years), and added a minimal Stop() lifecycle method. Declared phish_server.trusted_proxies = ["127.0.0.1/32"] in the Ansible-provisioned config.json after auditing the actual nginx proxy_pass target (127.0.0.1:8080, the phishing server; the admin server is not fronted by this nginx vhost at all and is left at the trust-none default). Added docs/TRUSTED_PROXY_RESOLUTION.md covering configuration syntax, both deployment modes, the trust algorithm, and the breaking-change rationale. Added focused tests for every required scenario (direct-peer spoofing, untrusted-proxy peer, trusted rightmost-hop selection, multi-hop chains, malformed/oversized headers, X-Real-IP fallback rules, the central same-client/different-forged-XFF same-bucket proof, and periodic-cleanup purge under -race without a real-time sleep) plus config-load validation tests for invalid/valid/absent trusted_proxies. No new Go or JS dependency; go.mod/go.sum/package.json/yarn.lock are byte-identical to the base commit. No /api/* rate limiter was added. Full ./scripts/verify.sh, plus gosec/govulncheck/gitleaks/actionlint/zizmor and the Docker/container/browser smoke scripts, all pass with no new findings relative to the base commit.

All 14 acceptance criteria verified: trusted-proxy model is explicit and defaults to trust-none with invalid entries rejected at load time; direct peers cannot spoof XFF/X-Real-IP to change their resolved IP; trusted-proxy chains are correctly resolved right-to-left; /login limiter uses the new resolver and is proven spoof-resistant under the central same-client/different-forged-XFF same-bucket proof; cleanup ticker bug is fixed and verified by periodic mechanism test under -race; no /api rate limiter added; dependencies unchanged; git authorship, GPG signature, and documentation all correct; all quality gates (build, vet, format, tests, race, lint, gosec, gitleaks, Windows cross-compile) pass.
